title: Localized TabICLv2: Scaling Tabular In-Context Learning through k-NN
abstract: arXiv:2608.16429v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundational models for tabular data have made significant progress in recent years, with TabICLv2 reporting state-of-the-art performance on several tabular classification tasks. However, full-context tabular ICL still suffers from attention cost that grows with the training-context size, which limits its ability to handle large datasets efficiently. Localized TabICLv2 introduces a method that reduces the inference cost of TabICLv2 by retrieving only the k nearest training neighbours for each test point, measured by similarity in the model's Stage 2 row-representation space, rather than using the full training context. This requires no architectural changes, and we show that accuracy retention can be improved through additional Stage 2 and Stage 3 fine-tuning. translated_title: 局部TabICLv2：通过k近邻扩展表格上下文学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：表格数据的基础模型近年来取得了显著进展，其中TabICLv2在多个表格分类任务上报告了最先进的性能。然而，全上下文表格上下文学习（ICL）仍面临注意力成本随训练上下文大小增长的问题，这限制了其高效处理大型数据集的能力。局部TabICLv2引入了一种方法，通过仅为每个测试点检索k个最近的训练邻居（基于模型第二阶段行表示空间中的相似度度量），而非使用完整训练上下文，来降低TabICLv2的推理成本。这无需架构更改，我们表明通过额外的第二阶段和第三阶段微调可以提高准确率保持度。在TabArena分类任务上，微调后的局部模型保留了完整TabICLv2准确率的98.64%，并在批量推理中实现了中位数2.18倍的加速，并达到...
tldr: 局部TabICLv2通过仅检索每个测试点的k个最近训练邻居来降低表格上下文学习的推理成本，在不改变架构的情况下保留了98.64%的准确率并实现了2.18倍的加速。
en_tdlr: Localized TabICLv2 reduces inference cost in tabular in-context learning by retrieving only k nearest training neighbors per test point, retaining 98.64% accuracy and achieving a 2.18x speedup without architectural changes.
